payload.name: Extract explicit hobby and passion statements as profile memories
payload.description: When a user directly states a person's hobby, passion, or interest in a short reply, extract it as a profile memory during construction.
content: During extraction, treat explicit statements of a person's hobbies, passions, or interests as memory-worthy even when they are short conversational replies and even when phrased with words like 'passion', 'love', 'was interested in', or 'great passion' instead of 'hobby'.
During CRUD, store such enduring facts as profile memories about the person, updating an existing profile for that person when available; otherwise add a new profile memory.

solves: The diagnosed cause was skipping a short direct statement of a hobby ('Travel was also her great passion!') during extraction. Future conversations contain brief replies to explicit interest questions; without this rule such durable facts are omitted. The abstraction instructs extracting explicit hobby/passion/interest statements and storing them as profile memories. Boundary: applies only to explicit statements, not inferred preferences.
